brief: Findings of the European Commission Rule of Law Report (Spain chapters 2020-2026), GRECO and the Venice Commission that name a specific act attributable to a party. Findings about the system with no specific act of a party (e.g. 'the CGPJ has not been renewed') are NOT events: list them in the part file top-level key 'system_findings' (same source shape, plus 'year' and one-line 'finding'). GRECO: a compliance report concluding that recommendations remain not implemented is attributed to the government of the day (attribution government_act, role national_government, indicator contrapesos or justicia as fits). You MAY add up to 3 more items of this kind for either PP or PSOE governments.

events.title: GRECO, cuarta ronda (España): cumplimiento «globalmente insatisfactorio» bajo el Gobierno Rajoy

events.status: firme; en 2019 GRECO concluyó que el cumplimiento ya no era «globalmente insatisfactorio» (GrecoRC4(2019)12)

attributions.note: Gobierno Rajoy II (PP); GRECO concluyó que el nivel de cumplimiento seguía siendo «globalmente insatisfactorio» y que la recomendación v (CGPJ) estaba parcialmente aplicada (§38, §76)
